results.name: E1 author transition + animations in the Motion panel → Ctrl+S → lxml reads exactly what was authored
E2 remove + undo / redo: the effect list follows the document
E3 show: Preview → shapes wait hidden → → plays Fly In (CSS animation) → → next slide enters through its transition → ← steps back built
E4 a deck with effects Fusion does not model: listed as kept; editing only the transition keeps every effect
E5 modal-shortcut test: Delete / Backspace / Ctrl+D typed in Motion fields or during the show never delete the shape or duplicate a slide
E7 presenter view (CA-02): the audience window gets the deck and follows the console; clicks on the audience advance the presenter; notes / next / timer on the console; End closes the audience
E6 no page errors during the Slides motion run
